measurement: eye diameter as percentage of head length
method: taxonomic description of the type series of a new species (preserved specimens)
conditions: Holotype GZNUSLS202507016 (38.3 mm SL) plus eight paratypes (35.1-77.5 mm SL), n = 9 (Methods: 'nine straight-bodied, fully intact specimens' measured with digital calipers); sexes not reported. Table 2 (percent HL): eye diameter holotype 9.1, range 9.1-17.3, mean 12.0, SD 2.7. Collected July 2024 and July 2025 with hand nets from subterranean river outlets in Xingyi City, Guizhou; 'Specimens of the new species were collected from a well, connected to the subterranean river.' The paper calls the eyes 'normal' and separates the species from congeners that 'either lack eyes or have reduced eye structures', but its Discussion also says the eye diameter is 'reduced relative to surface-dwelling species, but larger than in highly degenerate, typical cave-adapted species' (intermediate). Anatomy only; vision not tested.
